result.summary: Found 1 minor visual/accessibility issue: the promotion banner text has very low contrast against its pale background.

issues.description: The white headline and supporting text in the light mint promotional banner are difficult to read because they do not contrast sufficiently with the background, especially over the lighter decorative area on the right.
issues.suggestion: Use a darker text color, darken the banner background, or add a stronger overlay behind the text to ensure readable contrast.
